content: Hello! how can i help you?
I have a full-time W-2 job but also manage 3 rentals. Can I still qualify as a Real Estate Professional?

Possibly. If you can substantiate **750+ hours annually** and show that **more than 50% of your work hours** relate to your real estate activities, you may still qualify under **IRC §469(c)(7)**. Some taxpayers restructure their work year to hit this.

File **Form 8582**, elect to treat rental activities as non-passive, and attach a statement under **Reg. §1.469-9(g)**. Be sure to include hourly logs showing work performed, even if overlapping with other employment.
Can I backdate this election for last year?

Yes—under **Rev. Proc. 2011-34**, a **reasonable cause statement** may allow a late aggregation election, making the losses fully deductible. This route is commonly used by landlords with good documentation.
